strategies.name: Rebase/merge entire C001–C008 stack onto main
pros: Preserves linear county task history on main
Single integration path if main is quiet
cons: High collision risk while Builder 1 advances state/publication
Forces resolution of unrelated drift across long stack
Harder to review against current main

strategies.name: Squash county stack into one (or few) commits on main
cons: Less reviewable artifact-by-artifact against current main
Opaque blame for multi-county research trail
Still risky if publication paths overlap

strategies.name: Clean branch from current main + selective transplant of county artifacts
pros: Reviewable against current main while Builder 1 advances
Avoids rewriting live research stack history in place
Limits blast radius to county docs/data/scripts paths
Keeps Builder 1 state publication paths untouched
cons: Second branch to maintain until transplant PR merges

recommended_strategy_name: Strategy 3 — clean branch from current main + selective transplant of county artifacts
rationale: Prefer Strategy 3 for reviewability against current main while Builder 1 advances (including FL-010 wave1 apply). Strategy 2 squash is a fallback if a compact landing is required after gates clear. Strategy 1 full-stack rebase is rejected while publication work remains active.
